archetype: Organic & Earthy (Modified for Premium High-Contrast E-commerce)

tech_stack.styling: Vanilla CSS (Strictly separate .css files per component/page)
tech_stack.restrictions: NO Tailwind CSS, NO TypeScript, NO Emojis

hierarchy.h1: font-family: 'Outfit'; font-size: 3.5rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text-main);
hierarchy.h2: font-family: 'Outfit'; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--text-main);

design_patterns.glassmorphism: background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow);
design_patterns.glassmorphism_dark: background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 20px;

animations.floating_grocery: @keyframes float { 0% { transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px) rotate(0deg); } 33% { transform: translateY(-30px) translateX(10px) rotate(5deg); } 66% { transform: translateY(-10px) translateX(-10px) rotate(-5deg); } 100% { transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px) rotate(0deg); } }

buttons.primary: background: var(--primary); color: white; border: none; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 32px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Manrope'; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(11, 140, 76, 0.2);
buttons.primary_hover: background: var(--primary-hover); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(11, 140, 76, 0.3);

cards.product_card: Apply glassmorphism. Layout: Image wrapper at top with border-radius, followed by title, description, price (Rs) at bottom. Add primary Add-to-cart button.

inputs.default: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Manrope'; transition: all 0.2s ease; width: 100%;
inputs.focus: border-color: var(--primary); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-light);

login.layout: Full screen viewport. Background uses 'login_background' with a heavy overlay. Center the main login glass card. Provide inputs for Phone+OTP, and a Google Auth button.
login.animations: Inject floating grocery images into the background. Use position: absolute and apply the floating animation with different animation-delays to make them float continuously.

explore.layout: Sticky nav with Logo, Location Selector, Search bar, Profile icon. Below nav: horizontal scrollable category pills. Main section: CSS Grid of product cards.
explore.features: Fixed bottom floating cart bar (glassmorphic) that summarizes total cost and redirects to Cart.

store_selection.layout: Split view or modal: Sidebar for list of nearby stores (cards with distance) and main area for a Google Map placeholder visualization.

product_detail.layout: Clean two-column flex layout. Left: large high-quality product image container. Right: Title, exact Price (Rs), Description, Store Availability status, and Add to Cart action. Below: Related products row.

cart.layout: Left column: items list with increment/decrement quantity controls. Right column: sticky Order Summary (price breakdown) and Checkout button.

payment.layout: Forms for delivery address, radio buttons for Payment Methods (UPI, Card, COD). Right side: Order summary.
payment.animations: Add floating grocery items in random directions across the page. Success state modal uses premium glassmorphism.

profile.layout: Sidebar navigation (Orders, Addresses, Wishlist, Refunds, Fav Store, Help). Right content area displays corresponding details in glassmorphism cards.

testing_requirements.data_testid: ALL interactive components, inputs, links, buttons, and critical information blocks MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='add-to-cart').
